deep.resource_policy: Complete the full pathway-imagination workflow. Preserve substantial effort for generation, recombination, development and creative challenge; do not spend the run only on research.
deep.review: fresh-context grounding and creative challenge when available

extensive.resource_policy: Complete deep work, then use additional capacity for independent candidate generation, unfamiliar source domains, branch development, comparison and reconciliation. Add work only while it can change the result.
extensive.review: separate fresh-context grounding and creative challenge when feasible

brief.resource_policy: Only on an explicit user request for a quick or short sketch. Retain local factual qualifications, pathway conditions and honest limitations. Do not claim full-depth completion.

accounting: The default target ranges are provisional engineering starting points, not empirically validated optima. Set a profile target to null to disable it. Targets describe a planned run-wide envelope, not measured usage, a hard runtime cap or a minimum spend. Do not pad work to reach a token count. Actual input, output, cached input and reasoning counters require host telemetry with its accounting convention; absent telemetry is unknown.
